messages:
Ivy: quick flag  launch post performance looks odd  organic clicks spiked but downstream demos flat. see dashboard: https://dash.redwood/launch/post-q2
Omar: noted. which post? the product deep-dive or the benchmarking thread?
Ivy: the benchmarking thread (longform). referrals are up from tech-forums, but we see low demo CTA clicks.
Rhea: I pulled the event log: a lot of clicks are landing to the /blog#readmore anchor which prevents the sticky CTA from firing due to our scroll listener threshold.
Jon: ouch. so high traffic but the engagement hook doesn't trigger -> lower demo CTAs. any quick mitigations?
Rhea: two options: (1) lower scroll threshold so anchor clicks trigger CTA, (2) server-side temp banner for that blog slug. (1) is small JS patch, (2) is content change with ops.
Omar: for KPI review, we should surface per-slug engagement and conversion. Ivy can you add slug breakdown and time-to-cta metric to the dashboard?
Ivy: on it. quick SQL:

```
SELECT slug, count(*) clicks, sum(is_demo_cta_click::int) cta_clicks, avg(time_to_cta) avg_t
FROM events.page_clicks
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-24' AND campaign='q2-benchmark'
GROUP BY slug
ORDER BY clicks DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

Ivy: preliminary: /blog/q2-benchmark -> 8,900 clicks, CTA clicks 22 (0.25%), avg time_to_cta 42s. other slugs with sticky CTA avg CTA rate 1.6%.
Jon: that's a sizable gap. Rhea, can you ship the JS patch to lower the threshold to 10% and prod-heat it behind a feature flag for 2h? monitor funnel.
Rhea: yes. will open a small PR and toggle via feature flags. estimating 45m to rollout.
Omar: kpi-bot, can you add a KPI card for 'time-to-cta' and alert if CTA rate for top slug < 0.5% post-deploy?
kpi-bot: KPI card added: "time_to_cta" and alert rule created: top-slug CTA rate <0.5% -> paging to #marketing-alerts. Weekly snapshot: new visits +18%; demo CTA clicks -12% (24h). No ingestion anomalies.
Ivy: action list: (1) Rhea deploy JS tweak (rhea) (2) Ivy add slug breakdown to KPI dashboard (ivy) (3) Omar schedule follow-up in KPI review (omar).
Rhea: PR open: repo/website#458, flag toggled. starting canary now.
Ivy: initial canary shows CTA rate up from 0.25% -> 0.9% on canary slice after 18m. will watch 2h and report in KPI sync.
Jon: great. if stable, we can keep change and add a post-check for accessibility impact.
Ivy: noted. adding accessibility smoke test to the rollout checklist.
kpi-bot: Update: canary CTA rate 0.9% (canary slice) at 00:38 UTC. Added to tomorrow's weekly KPI agenda: "post change funnel validation".
Omar: thanks team, will include in KPI deck. reconvene in morning sync. :thumbsup:
